title: Regional stewardship allocator and hosted overspill safeguards
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: During regional capacity pressure we need deterministic tenant routing that prefers Dedicated capacity while guaranteeing SLA for critical customers via a controlled hosted spillover path. Current heuristics are brittle under sudden regional evictions and can escalate cost or increase latency unexpectedly. Goal: Implement a region-aware allocator that assigns 'stewardship' lanes to tenants, enforces preemptible grace budgets, and applies soft demotion to model variants before triggering hosted spillover. The allocator should be auditable, respect tenant reservation tiers, and expose clear telemetry for cost/latency trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: Allocator honors tenant reservation tiers (gold/silver/bronze) and routes >=95% of gold traffic to Dedicated when Dedicated pool has at least 10% spare capacity.

When Dedicated capacity drops below tenant's soft budget, allocator tries quantized model variant demotion (e.g., FP16->INT8) and verifies quality via fast prompt checks before routing to hosted; demotion must be limited to 5% of requests for high-risk tenants.

Hosted overspill path is gated by a circuit-breaker with hysteresis and tenant-weighted cooldowns; spillover cannot be used continuously for >10 minutes for the same tenant without an explicit operator override.
End-to-end tests and canary demonstrate no >10% increase in 95th percentile latency for gold tenants during controlled overload scenarios, and cost increase is bounded to configured thresholds.
Dashboard tile added to Console showing stewardship lanes, spillover counts, model-variant demotions, and per-tenant spillover duration for the last 24h.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Prototype an allocator service (k8s job) that consumes capacity snapshot feed and tenant reservations -> initial PR: routing/allocator#400
Phase 2: Integrate variant-demotion microservice that applies quantization profiles and fast quality checks -> PR: runtime/variant-demote#122
Phase 3: Circuit-breaker + cooldown engine in router (configurable per-tenant) -> PR: router/circuit-breaker#88
Phase 4: Observability (metrics + Console tile) and canary in us-west-2 with 5 gold tenants -> PR: console/metrics#59
Phase 5: Rollout with gradual traffic shift and runbook validation
metrics: Dedicated routing ratio (per-tier): target >=0.95 for gold when spare>=10%
Model-demotion success rate: fraction of demoted requests that pass fast-quality-check >= 0.98
Spillover activation rate: number of tenants with active spillover per region <= configured threshold
95th percentile latency change (gold tenants) during overload <= +10%
Per-tenant spillover duration: alert if > 10 minutes continuous
runbook_snippet: If region reports sustained Dedicated saturation >95% for 60s: 1) Trigger stewardship rebalancer to re-evaluate tenant lanes; 2) Apply model variant demotion to low-risk percentiles; 3) If demotion fails quality check, enable tenant-specific hosted spillover for up to 5 minutes and notify SRE; 4) If spillover persists beyond 10 minutes, escalate to on-call and automatically start capacity acquisition flow.
routing_policy_spec:
Algorithm overview:
- Input: capacity_snapshot (per-region, per-GPU-type), tenant_reservations, tenant_priority_score, model_variant_catalog
- Step A: Compute spare_capacity = pool_capacity - committed_reserved - current_inflight
- Step B: For each tenant sorted by priority_score: allocate stewardship_lane if spare_capacity_fraction >= tier_minimum (gold:0.10,silver:0.05,bronze:0.02)
- Step C: If allocation cannot be satisfied, attempt model_variant_demote(tenant, max_demote_fraction) where demote profiles are pre-approved quantization levels
- Step D: Run fast_quality_check(samples=3, threshold=0.95) -> if pass, route demoted fraction to Dedicated; else evaluate hosted_spill_candidate
- Step E: Hosted spillover paths require circuit-breaker: opened if tenant_hosted_spillover_time > tenant_cooldown_window OR region_spill_rate > global_threshold
- Notes: All decisions are logged with decision_id and can be replayed for audits
test_plan: Unit tests for allocator decision logic with synthetic capacity traces
Integration tests that exercise demotion + fast-quality checks using small prompt set
Chaos test: simulate regional node eviction and assert stewardship lanes reassign within 90s
Canary: enable for three low-risk tenants in us-west-2 and monitor metrics for 48h
Load test: spike traffic to validate circuit-breaker opens/closes correctly and spillover cooldowns behave as expected
risks: False positives in fast-quality-check could cause unnecessary model demotion and impact output quality
Complex per-tenant configs increase operational burden; must provide sane defaults
Telemetry cardinality may spike when logging decision_id per request; need aggregation strategy
